summary: Costume system for all 44 registered characters (S 1, A 7, B 11, extra 25 incl. told-only CHAR-tortoise): 52 outfits COS-001..COS-052, exactly one default per character (default_outfit_id), 10 explicit costume change points hung on story_timeline events, plus variant_points for wet/sooty/leaves/accessory states for continuity-planning.

acceptance.no_unknown_placeholder: PASS (check script scans for UNKNOWN/TBD/TODO/未知/待定/empty strings)
acceptance.costume_change_points_explicit: PASS: every CP has after_event, effective_from_event (+ paragraph where it splits ev0054), from/to outfits of the same character; all switches happen off screen between scenes so none falls inside a generation group
acceptance.source_quotes: PASS: every cited quote found in its cited paragraph of story/structured_story

key_decisions: Schema: platform characters[].outfits[] with COS-NNN ids, so costume sheets are sheet_<COS-id>.png; the skeleton's flat costumes[] list is dropped so core.py does not read entries twice.

Alice COS-001 (default, verbatim for sheet.png): pale cornflower-blue 1862 child's summer frock, white bib pinafore with a pocket, white stockings, black ankle-strap shoes (user ref refs/style/alice.jpeg). She wears it through the whole dream; the only change is the grown-Alice reverie insert COS-002 (age02, ch012#p71).

Wet, sooty, leaf-strewn, tea-splashed, one-glove and spectacles states are variants with on/off events, not separate outfits (SOUL: per-shot state is continuity-planning's job). The Caucus-race members are drawn dry by default; soaked ev0009-ev0010.

Sourced changes: King is bareheaded in the procession because the Knave carries his crown (ch008-p11), then wears the crown over a judge's wig at the trial (COS-010, ch011-p03); Knave in chains at the trial (COS-012); White Rabbit becomes herald (COS-007).

Designed changes, each with a reason: the Duchess wears outdated visiting finery for the Queen's croquet invitation (COS-014); the cook puts on a shawl and bonnet to go to court (COS-039); Bill wears a borrowed juror's coat (COS-032); the sister's courtroom glimpse adds a shawl and bonnet (COS-004, ruling 5.3 B).

Doubling echoes (5.3 B): housemaid's white bib apron echoed by Alice's pinafore; Cheshire Cat in Dinah's brown-tabby palette; the sister's lilac-grey dress kept under the gallery shawl so she is recognisable on the wake-up cut.

DEF-p3-char-index-902 honoured: the executioner reads from dark crimson livery and a pushed-back black hood only. No device of any kind; the banned words stay out of visual_en (prohibited_in_prompt only).
Palette rules applied: cornflower only on Alice; Hearts crimson only on the Hearts household; Caterpillar set to slate blue (conflict filed).
DEF-p3-char-index-903 (ch006 chorus attribution) was checked: it has no costume impact.
